description: RONIT SAHA ROY ,NAMAN AGARWAL ,RANADEEP PAUL ,HANISH SINGHA
summary: Marswalk 360 is an immersive, interactive web application designed to bring the surface of the Red Planet directly to users through a 360-degree virtual exploration experience. Hosted on Netlify, the project simulates an authentic Martian environment, allowing visitors to look around and experience what standing on Mars feels like through engaging panoramic visuals. Built with web technologies, it serves as an exciting and accessible digital platform for space enthusiasts to explore planetary landscapes right from their browsers.
details:
Marswalk 360 acts as a virtual Martian simulation right inside your web browser. Specifically, it:

-Presents a 360-Degree Panorama: It immerses users in a full spherical or panoramic view of the Martian surface, letting them look around in all directions rather than just viewing a flat image.

- Simulates Planetary Exploration: It gives visitors a sense of presence on another world, making the Red Planet's terrain accessible without needing specialized VR hardware.
